d: A day after the Aam Aadmi Party released its first list of 40 candidates for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections, two of its MLAs quit the party. Chetan Singh Jouramajra from Samana, a former minister in the Bhagwant Mann government, and Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra from Sanaur resigned on November 1. At a press conference in Chandigarh, they launched a series of allegations against their own government, over the drug crisis, the death of Gulzar Singh, the police taking away the body of a youth in Mansa, the appearance of AAP MLAs and ministers before the Akal Takht, Punjab’s mounting debt,…
